question: When did Central Library open?
answer: Central Library opened in 1962 [S3].

question: Which branch opened most recently?
answer: The Mill Creek branch is the newest, having opened in September 2019. [S1][S3]

question: How often does the Board of Trustees meet?
answer: The Board of Trustees meets on the second Tuesday of each month [S1].

question: What do I need to bring to get a library card?
answer: To obtain a library card, you must provide a photo ID and proof of a local address, such as a utility bill dated within the last 60 days [S1].

question: Can a 15-year-old sign up for a card without a parent?
answer: Yes, teens aged 13 to 17 can sign up for a library card on their own by using a school ID [S1].

question: How much does a non-resident card cost?
answer: A non-resident library card costs $35 per year [S1].

question: How long can I borrow a DVD?
answer: DVDs and video games are loaned for 7 days [S1].

question: What is the maximum number of items I can check out?
answer: You can have up to 30 items checked out at once, with a limit of no more than 10 DVDs [S1].

question: How many times can I renew a book?
answer: You can renew items up to two times, provided that no one else has placed a hold on them [S1].

question: How long is a hold kept for me?
answer: When an item you have placed on hold arrives, it is kept on the hold shelf for 5 days before it is passed on to the next person [S1].

question: Are there late fees for overdue books?
answer: No, Harbor City Public Library has been fine-free since March 2023 and does not charge daily fines for overdue items [S1].

question: When is an overdue item considered lost?
answer: An item is marked as lost when it is 45 days overdue [S1].

question: At what balance is my borrowing blocked?
answer: Borrowing is paused when an account owes $25 or more in fees [S3].

question: What is the Wi-Fi network called?
answer: The Wi-Fi network available at every branch is named HCPL-Public [S1].

question: How much does color printing cost?
answer: Color printing costs 50 cents per page [S2].

question: How far ahead can I book a study room?
answer: You can book a study room up to 14 days in advance [S1].

question: What do I need to do before using the 3D printer?
answer: Before using the 3D printers at the Central Library, members must complete a free 45-minute safety orientation [S1].

question: What time does Central Library open on Sunday?
answer: The Central Library opens at 1 p.m. on Sunday. [S1]

question: Are the smaller branches open on Mondays?
answer: No, the Northshore, Eastgate, and Mill Creek branches are closed on Mondays [S1].

question: What is the phone number for the information desk?
answer: The phone number for the Central Library information desk is (555) 010-4422 [S2].

question: Does the library keep a record of what I borrowed?
answer: The library only keeps your borrowing history until an item is returned, unless you have enabled the optional reading-history feature in your account [S1].

question: Can I eat food in the library?
answer: Food is only permitted in the Central Library cafe and in study rooms [S1].
